newsitem.title: USA: Genome Therapeutics in pact with Bayer.
newsitem.headline: Genome Therapeutics in pact with Bayer.

text.p: Genome Therapeutics Corp said Monday that it has signed an agreement to provide Bayer AG with non-exclusive access to the company's proprietary database, PathoGenome.
The agreement with Bayer is the company's first subscription to the database.
The subscription agreement includes annual subscription fees and royalties on any small molecules developed as a result of access to the information provided by PathoGenome.
Genome said it retains all rights associated with the therapeutic, diagnostic and vaccine use of bacterial genes or gene products.
